Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent is 0136. Hold Alt, type 0136 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent also has the Unicode codepoint U+02C6, so you can type it with Alt+710 on Windows, search for U+02C6 in macOS's Character Viewer, use ˆ in HTML, or \02C6 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥I for Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent; shortcuts can differ on other layouts. HTML also defines the named entity ˆ for Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent, but the numeric form ˆ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type modifier letter circumflex accent on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 1 3 6 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent character (ˆ) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type modifier letter circumflex accent on macOS

On a US keyboard layout, press ⌥I to insert Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent. This shortcut assumes a US layout; other layouts may remap it.

If the shortcut does not work on your layout, open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent" and click the character.

How to use modifier letter circumflex accent in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\02C6"; ()
  • Python: \u02C6 or chr(0x2C6)
  • JavaScript: \u02C6 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2C6)
  • JSON: "\u02C6"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent?

The legacy Alt code for Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent is 0136. Hold Alt, type 0 1 3 6 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ˆ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ˆ, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+710 not work?

Alt+710 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent?

The Unicode codepoint for Modifier Letter Circumflex Accent is U+02C6. You can use this value in HTML as ˆ, in CSS as \02C6, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ˆ on a Mac?

On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥I. If that does not work on your layout, open ⌃⌘Space and search for U+02C6.
